page.title: One input. Two approaches.
page.subtitle: Compare existing algorithm visualizations side by side, one recorded step at a time.

setup.graphHelp: Write undirected edges as A-B or weighted edges as A-B:4. Separate edges with commas. Traversal compares visit order; MST compares the selected edges and total weight.
setup.operationsHelp: Use insert 10 and delete, separated by commas. Both structures receive the same sequence. A stack removes the newest value (LIFO); a queue removes the oldest (FIFO). Ignored removes on an empty structure are skipped in its trace.
setup.arrayHelp: 1–32 whole numbers, 0–99. Each algorithm receives its own copy of the same array.
setup.treeHelp: 1–10 whole numbers, 0–99. Values are inserted in the written order; duplicates are ignored — a duplicate insert still appears as a step so both traces stay aligned.
setup.targetHelp: Binary and jump search require ascending order. Prepare sorts one shared copy for both sides, including linear search. Sorting is preprocessing and is not counted in the search trace. With duplicates, algorithms may find different matching indices.

panel.narrationStart: Same starting input. Press Play or Next to begin.
panel.previewPlay: Press Play to insert values in order.

playback.disclaimer: One recorded step per side per tick. Finished panels hold their result. Step counts describe the teaching trace, not execution time or equal computational work.

empty.title: Explore how two algorithms solve the same problem
empty.body: Choose algorithms and a shared input, then prepare your comparison. Try different presets to see how their behavior changes.

errors.fallback: Unable to prepare this comparison. Check your input.
errors.sameAlgo: Choose two different algorithms to compare.
errors.graphEmpty: Add at least one edge, for example A-B:4.
errors.graphItem: Could not read "{{item}}". Use A-B for an unweighted edge or A-B:4 for a weighted edge.
errors.selfLoop: Edge {{edge}} is a self-loop. Use two different node names.
errors.weightRange: Edge weights must be greater than 0 and no more than 999.
errors.duplicateEdge: Edge {{edge}} is listed more than once.
errors.tooManyNodes: Use no more than 12 graph nodes so both visualizations stay readable.
errors.tooManyEdges: Use no more than 24 edges so both visualizations stay readable.
errors.opEmpty: Add at least one operation, for example "insert 10, delete".
errors.opRange: Operation values must be between -999 and 999.
errors.opNoValue: Operation "{{item}}" should not include a value.
errors.needsInsert: Add at least one insert operation.
errors.treeRange: Enter 1–10 comma-separated whole numbers from 0 to 99. Insertion order matters.
errors.treeValues: Use values from 0 to 99 so both trees share the same keys.
errors.arrayRange: Enter 1–32 comma-separated whole numbers from 0 to 99. Empty entries are not allowed.
errors.arrayValues: Use values from 0 to 99 so both visualizations can share this input.
errors.target: Enter a whole-number search target from 0 to 99. It does not need to be present in the array.
